condition_details.condition_comment: Plasma creatinine was measured (0 is the unmeasured default)

action_details.action_comment: Cockcroft-Gault style: CCr = ((140 - age) * lean body weight) / (PCr * 72)
action_details.action_postfix: 140 patient.age - patient.lean_body_weight fmul patient.pcr 72 fmul fdiv cvd /result.ccr xdef

action_details.action_dsl: add "CCr estimated via Cockcroft-Gault from age, lean body weight, and plasma creatinine." to result.rationale
action_details.action_postfix: "CCr estimated via Cockcroft-Gault from age, lean body weight, and plasma creatinine." result.rationale swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: add "CCr not computed: plasma creatinine was not supplied, so no renal dose adjustment was considered." to result.rationale
action_details.action_postfix: "CCr not computed: plasma creatinine was not supplied, so no renal dose adjustment was considered." result.rationale swap addto
